record.label: production-branch reference; deployment unverified
record.scope: The units in appliesTo declare RAZOR_WIND in this production reference. The strategy is shared; differences are star count, stats, range and passive.
record.summary: Deals one SPECIAL hit (raw 20/40/80/160 by caster stars) to the cast target, the caster's current target. No area, status, movement, heal or shield. canCritByDefault is true, so castAbility rolls chance(critChance / 100) for every cast WITHOUT needing ABILITY_CRIT; the roll can fail, so a crit is not automatic (executed: roll 0.01 at critChance 10 crits, roll 0.9 does not; a crit doubles the damage at critPower 2). The strategy passes the board to handleSpecialDamage but selects no geometry or area.

targeting.who: the cast target passed to the strategy (the caster's current target) only
targeting.note: requiresTarget is the base default true, so a target is needed to cast; how the target is chosen before the cast was not read.

effects.scaling: AP: damage x (1 + AP/100) (apBoost defaults to true); the cast's crit flag multiplies by critPower (reduced by the target's crit reduction) when the cast rolled a crit; canCritByDefault is true so the crit is rolled with chance critChance/100 for every cast
effects.resolution: requested = the raw amount; applied = after AP/crit, the target's SPE_DEF division and later untraced modifiers (core-mechanics section A: division by 1 + 0.05 x SPE_DEF, ceil, minimum 1); a protect / skydiving / magicBounce target takes none. The returned takenDamage is unused (core-mechanics section J1).

starBehavior.note: indexed by the casting entity's stars; the 4-star entry (160, also the fallback) are declared in the tables but unused by the bound baseline classes. maxPP and range are in appliesTo.

record.positionalConditions: None: the strategy reads no coordinates; only the cast target matters.
record.repeatedCastsAndModes: No stored state or modes. Each cast spends maxPP of PP and hits the target once.
record.rawVsResolved: Declared raw: 20/40/80 (1/2/3 stars). Damage dealt = raw x (1 + AP/100) [x crit factor], then the target's SPE_DEF division (ceil, at least 1) and untraced modifiers.
dependsOnUnverifiedGenericCombat: Final damage after handleSpecialDamage's later modifiers (SPE_DEF division, shields, items, resurrection, field multipliers); only the shared references in core-mechanics section A were consulted
When the cast fires in a real fight (PP gain, targeting, silence); only the pp >= maxPP && canCast gate was read
Crit chance value (critChance) and critPower; only the roll gate was located
unresolved: Passives declared by the listed units (see appliesTo) are not covered by this record
Whether the units ever reach a different star count than the bare factory value

Evidence: source reading, mechanical checks and executed probes. The pinned helper text (castAbility (crit roll), handleSpecialDamage, handleDamage) and the real RazorWindStrategy strategy text were run against stand-in units with controlled callbacks (probes/pinned-helper-probe.mjs, section CATCHUP_B2); the whole ability in a real fight, targeting and timing before the cast, and full battles were NOT executed, and nothing was observed in a live game. Executed (stand-in caster and target, controlled roll): the table requests, the board argument, the doubling by a crit and the rolled versus not-rolled cases for RAZOR_WIND against PECK.
